# Day Diabetes

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The record of diabetes-relevant data for a day (glucose, insulin, carbs, events).

## Scope note

Produced by the Morning Review workflow from Dexcom and Glooko data for the previous day.

- [Day Cluster Health](../DayClusterHealth/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
